$comment: zDSH dependency-face lint configuration (A2, upgrade process v2.0 section 6). Contract face = the published host surface plugin repositories may import (bare package specifiers and their declared export subpaths such as /client). Anything under the host org outside the contract face is a violation: deep-path reaches into src/internal or direct source files, internal-face imports of host wiring packages, and non-contract-face imports of unpublished or non-plugin-facing host packages. defaultTargets = the five true-source repositories carrying the seven factory-seeded artifacts (seed.json entries: webstack-verticals/webstack-bridge/webstack live in WebStack; omnivision in Omnivision; filehub in FileHub; plugin-center in PluginCenter; autopilot in AutoPilot). pluginsRoot is the zDSH workstation default and is overridable via --plugins-root. Exemptions are load-bearing records, not silencers: each needs a reason and is reported on every run.

exemptions.reason: zDSH-Go exclusive (process v2.0 D2/NG3): not in defaultTargets; its 372+ host imports / 15 deep paths are recorded legacy debt owned by the Go line, not gated here.
